name: Kroger Grocery Distribution Center Shelbyville IN

fieldNotes.truckGate: Open access. Street View (Aug 2024, pano K5evSTQ4ZAhonQqEbiNukg on County Rd 125 W) shows the public road running straight into the property past a Kroger monument sign with no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point. The drive opens directly onto the yard.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible at the entrance in Street View or satellite. The only small structures near the truck path are the office/break facilities attached to the main building, not a gate booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no controlled gate at all (remoteGs requires a gate without a shack).
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: A separate oval staging/parking loop with a small structure sits south of the yard (~39.5843,-85.8110), usable for trucks to wait before entering; modeled as staging.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide internal paved yard between the north dock apron and the annex provides ample inside-the-property queueing before docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The entrance drive from County Rd 125 W runs several hundred meters of open paved approach into the yard, easily holding 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long continuous dock bank along the main building's north face with trailers backed in across its full length, plus annex docks. Counted bands well over 50; estimate ~110 total. Honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large west-end drop yard plus annex trailer lot, both packed with dozens of drop trailers (no tractors). Clearly 50+.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: main ~600k sqft refrigerated DC plus a separate annex building (own docks/parking/trailer lot) to the north, and a small ancillary building east.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property; nearest linear feature east is the Shelbyville Municipal Airport runway, not rail.
fieldNotes.scale: No clearly identifiable truck scale pad in the truck path; left false but listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors appear concentrated on the main building's north face (single cluster); annex has its own docks but reads as overflow rather than a separate ship/rcv split. Low confidence, left false.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural setting (farmland) but adjacent to Shelbyville and a municipal airport, so cellular coverage is likely adequate; left false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~60 acres is the polygon-traced developed/paved footprint; public sources cite a ~100-acre owned campus including surrounding buffer land.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Approx count across drop yard + dock apron + annex from z18-20 imagery; honest estimate.

citations.claim: Kroger took over operation of the 600,000 sqft Shelbyville IN DC at 4301 N 125 W from Penske, effective Sept 11 2022.
Kroger Supply Chain manages the Kroger DC complex in Shelby County, built by Kroger in 1998 on a 100-acre campus serving 10 states.

verification.rationale: Kroger self-operates the Shelbyville refrigerated DC (in-housed from Penske Sept 2022); no closure/sale found.
